item.title: Pasting images into remote Codex sessions
item.description:
My earlier post Seamless remote coding sessions shows how I use Tailscale, Eternal Terminal and tmux to work on a Linux machine at home from my MacBook. The remote sessions appear as regular iTerm2 panes, and reconnect when my network comes back.

Often, I screenshot a window or area on my laptop to instruct codex. With local sessions, pasting the image into codex shows a text like [Image #1] in the codex prompt input, and gives codex access to the image. With remote sessions this doesn’t work out-of-the-box: The screenshots will be stored in a tmp file locally that remote codex can’t access.
